$comment: Registry of every kya distribution channel: the single source of truth the maintainers' release fan-out gate and daily drift watchdog read. Every channel kya has or plans is listed with how its version is updated and a live probe. A file under the package that carries a version must be a channel file here or be listed in not_channels with a reason, or CI fails. A channel with its own version line (VS Code extension, n8n node) has own_version {file, pattern}: at a kya tag the expected live version is captured from that file at the tag, not the kya version. Paths are relative to the maintainers' monorepo root; {version} in a probe url is the version under test. No version pins in this file.

update_values.auto-pipeline: a monorepo Woodpecker workflow updates it on every kya-v* tag; a lag after grace_hours is red. Optional min_version: tags older than it print UNRESOLVED (the channel was automated later); lint fails when it is more than one minor above sdks/kya/package.json
update_values.auto-mirror: it lives in the public repo The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya, which kya-public-sync mirrors on every tag; a lag after grace_hours is red
update_values.auto-runtime: it installs npm latest when it runs; nothing to bump per release
update_values.manual-owner: a human updates it; always printed as UNRESOLVED with the action, never green. Needs owner_reason and a since date (YYYY-MM-DD): without them the release gate is red; a reason older than 30 days prints WARN, and lint fails past 90 days
update_values.not-built: planned or drafted, not published; always printed as UNRESOLVED with what blocks it. Same owner_reason and since rule as manual-owner

channels.where: pypi.org/project/shield-kya (version lockstep with package.json: pyproject.toml and __version__ in sdks/kya-python)
channels.by: maintainers' release pipeline: pypi-publish.yml on the kya-v* tag (GitHub Actions, Trusted Publishing), after npm serves the version
channels.note: Watched only at a tag whose pyproject.toml carries the tag version. kya-v0.32.7 and older tags carry 0.17.0 and print UNRESOLVED. check-version-pins keeps the Python version equal to package.json on every main commit, so kya-v0.32.8 and later enforce.

channels.kind: VS Code Marketplace extension (own version line, starts at 0.1.0)
channels.by: GitHub Actions workflow kya-vsix-publish.yml on the kya-v* tag (vsce, Trusted Publishing with OIDC, no stored token)
channels.note: The extension has its own version line: at a kya tag the expected live version is the one in sdks/kya/vscode/package.json at that tag, not the kya version. Enforced from the first tag cut with kya-vsix-publish.yml; older tags carried 0.1.0 and were never pipeline-published, so they print UNRESOLVED. The workflow publishes only when that version is not live yet, so a kya tag without a vscode version bump keeps the live version and stays green. Listing text = channel-copy variants.vscode plus the features in features.required.

channels.kind: Open VSX extension (Cursor, VSCodium; same package as vscode-marketplace)
channels.by: GitHub Actions workflow kya-vsix-publish.yml uploads the .vsix (OVSX_PAT); the owner waits for Eclipse to verify the namespace
channels.owner_reason: 0.1.1 published by the pipeline but inactive until Eclipse verifies the namespace claim EclipseFdn/open-vsx.org#15656
channels.action: Uploaded by the pipeline but inactive: the open-vsx.org API returns 404 until Eclipse approves the namespace claim https://github.com/EclipseFdn/open-vsx.org/issues/15656. When the claim is approved and the probe reads the version, set update to auto-pipeline. Listing text = channel-copy variants.vscode.

channels.owner_reason: Source is mirrored (kya-n8n-mirror.yml, no tag), npm is not published. Owner steps: (1) publish a placeholder 0.0.1 under --tag bootstrap, (2) set the npm trusted publisher for @shield-agent/n8n-nodes-kya (repo The-Pixel-Boys/n8n-nodes-kya, workflow npm-publish.yml), (3) run kya-n8n-mirror by hand so it tags v0.1.0 and publishes with provenance, (4) submit in the n8n Creator Portal.
channels.action: Not published (npm 404). Owner does steps 1 to 4 in owner_reason, in that order. When the probe reads the version, set update to auto-pipeline (add grace_hours and by for the publishing workflow). Provenance is mandatory for n8n verification.

GitHub repo About, npm, PyPI, MCP registry, VS Code Marketplace and Open VSX are compared live by kya-channel-copy-live.sh: the release fan-out goes red on a mismatch and the daily run keeps one listing drift issue.
